name: Loading Button
summary: A button that reports its own pending state — aria-busy plus a live region, never disabled, and never a new name. Four live failures: the silent spinner, the lost focus, the label used as a status, and the cue that disappears when motion is off.
demoNote: Examples 2 to 5 are live and half wrong on purpose. Example 2's spinner-only button announces nothing; example 3's disabled button drops focus to the document body the moment it is pressed; example 4's renaming button ends up with three different names; example 5's dot is indistinguishable from its resting state once motion is off.

contract.useWhen: A button that is working, saying so to someone who cannot see the spinner.
keyboard: native: aria-disabled blocks the handler, so a second press does nothing
states: busy — aria-busy=true and aria-disabled=true, set only while pending
failureModes: no aria-busy and no region, so the only cue is an animation
the disabled attribute while pending, which drops focus and announces nothing
the label swapped to a progress word, renaming the control mid-press
the spinner as the only cue, gone under forced colors and reduced motion
